lora_r.failure_mode: Set very low and the adapter has too few parameters to learn anything, and training 'succeeds' with a model that barely moved. micro_batch_size.failure_mode: Raised without room in VRAM and the run OOMs minutes in, after the machine is paid for. Lowered and the run is slower than the predictor priced, because the effective batch shrank.

save_steps.failure_mode: Set too frequently and checkpoint writes blow through the disk the platform sized from save_total_limit; set too rarely and resume has no recent checkpoint to continue from.
